_seam: The item master, the stowage tree, units, suppliers and categories now come from TM Master, projected into data/procurement/catalogue.json by tools/build-procurement-catalogue.py (IDMS-SCHEMA §42.14). This module reads that projection and never writes back. The arrays below are only a fallback for a vessel with no TM Master export at all; when the catalogue loads, it wins. `settings` is the one block the PWA writes, ETag-guarded.
